Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 2026

This policy applies to Kinnav, developed and published by American Group LLC, on iOS and Android.

ApplicationKinnav
iOS bundle idcom.americangroupllc.kinnav
Android packagecom.americangroupllc.kinnav
DeveloperAmerican Group LLC
Contactcontact@americangroup.ai

Accounts

You may create an account with Sign in with Google or Sign in with Apple. When you do, we receive the identifier the provider returns, your email address, and the display name you choose. Accounts are stored with Supabase (Supabase Inc.) under an encrypted connection. An account is required for the features that save data to your profile. You can delete your account and its data at any time — see Delete your account.

Device permissions

The app asks for the following permissions only when you use the related feature, and each request explains its purpose with the text below. You can decline any of them and keep using the rest of the app.

  • Camera — Kinnav lets you take a profile photo with your camera.
  • Location (while using the app) — Kinnav uses your location to show where you are on the home screen and to include it in the Safe Call text to your safety contacts.
  • Photo library — Kinnav lets you choose a profile photo from your photo library.

Android permissions declared: ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION, ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, INTERNET.

Advertising

The app does not show advertisements and does not include an advertising SDK.

Purchases

The app has no in-app purchases.

Analytics and crash reporting

To find and fix problems, the app sends crash reports through Google Firebase Crashlytics (the error, the device model, operating system and app version, and a random installation identifier); and anonymous usage statistics and performance measurements through Google Firebase Analytics and Performance Monitoring. This data is not linked to your name or account, is not used for advertising, and is processed by Google under Firebase's privacy terms.

Network

The app connects to the internet to provide its features and to your account backend. Connections use HTTPS.

Data retention and deletion

Account data is kept until you delete your account, after which it is removed from our systems within 30 days. Anything stored only on your device is removed when you uninstall the app.

Children

The app is not directed to children under 13 and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them.

Your rights

You may ask us to access, correct or delete personal data we hold about you by emailing contact@americangroup.ai. We answer within 30 days.

Changes

We will post any change to this policy on this page with a new date.
